set -eu

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
maildir=$base/Maildir

for box in accounts support general; do
    mkdir -p "$maildir/$box/tmp" "$maildir/$box/new" "$maildir/$box/cur"
done

tmp=$(mktemp "$maildir/general/tmp/deliver.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f -- "$tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

cat > "$tmp"

department=$(
    awk '
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "")
                exit
            if (line ~ /^[ \t]/)
                next
            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon > 0 && tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1)) == "x-department") {
                value = substr(line, colon + 1)
                sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
                sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
                department = value
            }
        }
        END { print department }
    ' "$tmp"
)

case "$department" in
    accounts) box=accounts ;;
    support)  box=support ;;
    *)        box=general ;;
esac

destination=$(mktemp "$maildir/$box/new/$(date +%s).$$.XXXXXXXXXX")
mv -f -- "$tmp" "$destination"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
DELIVER_EOF
chmod 0755 /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s path=%n' /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver
